profile.name: Saurabh Rajendra Jadhav
profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer | Next.js, Node.js & Applied AI
profile.bio: Full-stack engineer with 3+ years at Livlong 365, promoted from Management Trainee to Assistant Manager within two years. Co-led a Next.js migration that improved LCP by ~45% and built a lab-test platform indexing 500+ tests from 32+ NABL-accredited labs across 19,000+ pincodes for Livlong's 1.17M+ customer base. Independently built and operates Claratto and CinematicTale, with 500+ active users combined.

experiences.description: Promoted from Management Trainee to Assistant Manager within 2 years — recognized as Major Contributor and integral team member across multiple key product initiatives. Co-led (2-person) full platform migration from Svelte/Remix to Next.js App Router with TypeScript, improving Largest Contentful Paint by ~45%. Sole owner of the Lab Test feature (livlong.com/lab-test) — built full-stack from scratch: Node.js/Express REST API, Elasticsearch full-text search, and Redis caching — indexing 500+ lab tests across 32+ NABL-accredited labs, serving 19,000+ pincodes for Livlong's 1.17M+ customer base. Designed and shipped a production AI chatbot for POS agents using OpenAI function calling and custom MCP tooling with a real-time typed streaming layer; agents now resolve queries, find policies, and complete bookings entirely from chat — eliminating manual navigation across multiple portal pages. Consolidated three product codebases (main platform, Insurance, Wellness) into a unified 60+ component design system (Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui), standardizing UI/UX across the full product suite. Manages CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps; implements production observability and log monitoring with Grafana. Used React Query for server-state management across the Insurance platform's API layer. Actively participates in product planning sessions, database architecture discussions, and query optimization.

Led a 6-person team to design and build a custom CRM-based Android application from scratch using Java and Firebase, managing real-time database integration and user authentication. Revamped an existing user-facing service application, significantly improving its UI/UX and performance. Oversaw the full development lifecycle including code reviews, task delegation, and architectural planning.

projects.name: Claratto
projects.description: AI tutoring platform solving the trust problem in AI-assisted learning via a server-authoritative "test-gated knowledge graph." Mastery is only recorded after a server-scored assessment using Firebase Admin SDK — Firestore rules block all client writes, making proven knowledge unforgeable. Features multi-model LLM orchestration (Vercel AI SDK) routing between Claude and Gemini by subscription tier, Zod schema-validated structured output with streaming, and a real-time voice AI interview simulator using Sarvam AI speech-to-text with adaptive voice-activity detection. 100+ component TypeScript strict-mode codebase. Grew from a personal project to 500+ active users across Claratto and CinematicTale combined.

projects.name: CinematicTale
projects.description: Production Generative AI SaaS that turns a single-line prompt into fully illustrated storybooks, comic books, and AI video tales. Multi-model AI pipeline: Gemini 2.5 for narrative, Imagen 4 for illustration, Veo 3 for video — with panel-level scene decomposition, in-image dialogue lettering, and a character consistency engine across 10 art styles in 13 languages. Credit-based billing via Razorpay with an atomic Firestore debit/refund ledger. Hybrid architecture: serverless Next.js frontend on Vercel + Node.js/Express backend on AWS EC2, S3, CloudFront. Reduced page payload 96% (36.8 MB → 1.3 MB).

projects.name: OpenClaw
projects.description: Personal autonomous AI productivity platform and engineering lab — a multi-agent system built on a custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) agent harness where specialized agents handle distinct domains: a research agent monitors tech trends across fields and surfaces curated updates; a coding agent scaffolds prototypes, writes boilerplate, and assists with development tasks; a learning agent tracks progress and manages upskilling content; and a media agent generates marketing videos and visual assets. Each agent operates within isolated Docker containers orchestrated with Kubernetes on a self-managed Linux KVM VPS. Uses PostgreSQL and MongoDB for persistent agent memory and task history; GraphQL for querying structured external data sources; Jenkins for CI/CD pipeline automation of agent deployments. Served as a personal engineering sandbox for deepening infrastructure and database skills outside production constraints.
